setup.generator: Separate Seed3 open-drain output, 4.7k pull-up; disconnected from DUT sense input
reference_receivers: Analog-derived digital, low 1.2 V / high 2.0 V hysteresis

raw_reference.limitation: Stimulus-only check; does not qualify DUT behavior or service phase coverage.

scheduling.basis: Counted HSE/15 cycles at fixed nominal frequency; one constant offset; no fitted rate

hardware_clock.limitation: Every interior full clock period checked; initial gated period and boundary half-pulse widths reported separately. Relative clocks only; no DUT acceptance override.

period_populations.limitation: Every contained full period counted; histogram rounded to 1 ns for display only. Short/long mean more than half a nominal source-clock period from nominal; no periods removed from timing acceptance and no physical cause assigned.

dsp_dma.limitation: The DSP reference reuses the tested integer kernel. DMA timing/counters are device-reported; D4 independently checks audio callbacks, not the DMA2 bus. Silent outputs do not qualify codec audio quality.
